# Ralf

> Ralf is an AI-first SEO platform. It tracks how often your brand is named and cited across six AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Grok and Copilot — crawls your site for technical SEO issues, and gives you a prioritised weekly fix list. AI search visibility (AEO) and technical SEO in one tool.

## Pricing (USD / month, billed monthly; 2 months free on annual)
- Starter — $49: 1 site, 25 AI-search prompts tracked weekly across all 6 engines, 5 competitors, monthly site crawl. 14-day free trial, no card.
- Growth — $149: 3 sites, 100 prompts tracked weekly, 20 competitors, weekly crawl. 14-day free trial, no card.
- Pro — $299: 8 sites, 200 prompts tracked weekly, up to 10 countries each fully scored, 50 competitors, daily crawl.
- Agency — from $799: unlimited sites & competitors, 600+ prompts tracked weekly (custom volumes), white-label reports, API access.
- Every plan tracks all 6 AI engines weekly.

## Ralf Content
- Ralf creates the default keyword strategy automatically. It validates opportunities, groups canonical keywords into intent clusters and prioritises them using business relevance, search intent, demand, difficulty, competitor gaps, existing momentum and topic coverage.
- Users can inspect estimated monthly searches, keyword difficulty, coverage and mapped articles, then add, pause, exclude, prioritise or move a keyword and rename a cluster. Active canonical targets feed new content plans.
- The automatic content mix supports guides, how-tos, listicles, comparisons, competitor alternatives, use-case pages, industry pages, integration pages, and pricing and value pages.
- Evidence-led formats — FAQs, glossaries, case studies, original research and data reports, tools, local and programmatic pages, and link-worthy assets — use dedicated workflows when the required evidence or data exists.
- There is no content format that guarantees an AI citation. Ralf structures pages around precise questions, direct answers, named criteria, comparison tables where useful, internal topic connections and checkable evidence.
- Estimated keyword demand and difficulty are kept separate from actual Search Console impressions, clicks and position, and from observed AI mentions and citations.
- Users choose which automatic content types are included and can adjust their balance; Ralf uses a recommended mix when they do not customise it.

## How Ralf compares to other AI-visibility tools
- Ralf tracks 6 AI engines weekly from $49/mo. At the 100-prompt tier, Growth is $149 (6 engines) vs Peec Pro $199 (3 engines), Otterly Standard $189 (6 engines), and Profound ~$399 (3 engines).
- Unlike pure AI-visibility trackers (Profound, Peec, AthenaHQ), Ralf also includes a technical SEO crawler with a prioritised fix list and competitor analysis.
- Ralf tracks weekly rather than daily: AI answers change little day to day, so weekly coverage of six engines is more complete than daily coverage of three, and keeps pricing honest.
